Let me continue reading the pipeline steps and key helpers.
Let me read the helper classes that carry validation logic referenced by the steps.

The endpoint is defined by `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — a single 26-step function pipeline, all steps under `govern: [ transaction ]` so everything commits once at the very end (or rolls back on any escalation). Here is everything applied, in execution order. **[V]** = validation (can reject), **[S]** = side-effect (mutation/publish/persist/log).

**Guard (before any step)**
- **[V] Authorization** — `composition.authorize: hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`. No such role → 403 before the pipeline runs.

**Pipeline steps**

1. **[V/S] `CheckIdempotentCreate`** — reads the `Idempotency-Key` header (trimmed; blank/absent ignored). If that key was already recorded and its owner still exists and isn't soft-deleted → throws `IdempotentReplayException`, short-circuiting to a **200 replay** of the existing owner (no duplicate created). Otherwise does nothing.
2. **[V/S] `ValidateOwnerFields`** — binds `@RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` (the **only** body-binding step). First runs `OwnerAddresses.applyTo`: normalizes the address (structured `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` preferred over flat `address`; trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand `ST/RD/AVE`→`STREET/ROAD/AVENUE`) and composes a canonical flat `address` **[S]**. Then requires `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` all non-blank → else **400** `MissingOwnerFieldsException` naming each missing field. Publishes the validated body for later steps **[S]**.
3. **[V/S] `NormalizeOwnerTelephone`** — rewrites the telephone to E.164 in place **[S]**: strip spaces/dashes/brackets; a leading `+` keeps its country code, otherwise assume `+61` and drop one leading `0`. Must be 8–15 digits; known country codes enforce national length (`+61`→9, `+1`→10) → else **400** `InvalidTelephoneException`.
4. **[V/S] `NormalizeOwnerEmail`** — email is optional. If present, must be syntactically valid → else **400** `InvalidEmailException`; then lower-cased in place **[S]**. Absent/blank passes untouched.
5. **[V] `RejectDisposableEmailDomain`** — if an email is present and its domain is on the blocklist (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`) → **400** `DisposableEmailDomainException`.
6. **[S] `DeriveHouseholdId`** — computes a deterministic `householdId` = first 12 hex of SHA-256 over `V2|normalizedLastName|postcode` (null if no postcode) and publishes it as a pipeline variable. (Note: this reads `postcode` before postcode format is validated at step 11.)
7. **[V] `EnsureUniqueIdentity`** — the hard duplicate check. Computes `identityKey` = SHA-256 of `telephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName)`; if any non-soft-deleted existing owner has the same key → **409** `DuplicateIdentityException`.
8. **[V] `EnsureCityCapacity`** — counts existing owners in the same city (case-insensitive); if ≥ **50** → **409** `CityAtCapacityException`.
9. **[V] `EnsureDailyOwnerLimit`** — adjusts the effective registration date (supplied, else today) to a business day, counts existing owners registered on that day; if ≥ **100** → **429** `DailyOwnerLimitException`.
10. **[S] `BuildOwner`** — maps the DTO to an `Owner` entity via `OwnerMapper` and publishes it.
11. **[V] `ValidateOwnerPostcode`** — postcode optional; if present must be exactly 4 digits, and if the owner's **city** maps to a known region (Sydney→NSW 2000–2099, Melbourne→VIC 3000–3099, Brisbane→QLD 4000–4099) must fall in that range → else **400** `InvalidPostcodeException`.
12. **[S] `AssignHousehold`** — stamps the derived `householdId` onto the owner (if non-null).
13. **[S] `AssignHouseholdSize`** — sets `householdSize` = 1 + count of stored owners sharing the same non-null `householdId` (1 if no household).
14. **[S] `AssignMembershipLevelCap`** — if in a shared household, sets `membershipLevelCap` = max household member's level-for-current-size + 1 (unset otherwise).
15. **[V] `ValidateOwnerRegistrationDate`** — if a `registrationDate` was supplied and is after today → **400** `FutureRegistrationDateException`.
16. **[S] `DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate`** — sets `registrationDate` to the supplied value (or today if absent), rolled forward to the next business day (skipping weekends and the fixed 2026 public-holiday list) in place.
17. **[S] `AssignBulkSignupWarning`** — sets `bulkSignupWarning = true` if > **80** owners already exist for that business day.
18. **[S] `AssignCapacityWarning`** — sets `capacityWarning = true` if the city already holds **40–49** owners.
19. **[S] `AssignMemberId`** — computes and stamps the `memberId` (`<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` with a Luhn check digit), de-duplicating against existing member ids by appending `-2`, `-3`, ….
20. **[S] `AssignNamesakeCount`** — sets `namesakeCount` = count of existing owners sharing this first+last name (case-insensitive; 0 for the first).
21. **[S] `DetectPossibleDuplicate`** — soft match: if a non-deleted owner shares `soundex(lastName)` + `postcode` but has a different `identityKey`, sets `possibleDuplicate = true` and `possibleDuplicateOf` = lowest matching id; otherwise both cleared.
22. **[S] `SaveOwner`** — persists the owner via `OwnerRepository.save` (assigns its id).
23. **[S] `AuditOwnerCreated`** — logs a human-readable audit line plus a structured `schemaVersion:2` `OWNER_CREATED` event on the `AUDIT` logger, incrementing a process-wide sequence number.
24. **[S] `EnqueueWelcomeNotification`** — logs a welcome line (id + memberId) on the `NOTIFY` logger.
25. **[S] `RecordIdempotentCreate`** — if the request carried an `Idempotency-Key`, records key → new owner id in the `IdempotencyStore` (so step 1 can replay next time).
26. **[S] `RespondWithOwnerCreated`** — maps to `OwnerDto` and sends **201 Created** with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`.

The endpoint is defined by `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — a single 26-step function pipeline, all steps under `govern: [ transaction ]` so everything commits once at the very end (or rolls back on any escalation). Here is everything applied, in execution order. **[V]** = validation (can reject), **[S]** = side-effect (mutation/publish/persist/log).

**Guard (before any step)**
- **[V] Authorization** — `composition.authorize: hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`. No such role → 403 before the pipeline runs.

**Pipeline steps**

1. **[V/S] `CheckIdempotentCreate`** — reads the `Idempotency-Key` header (trimmed; blank/absent ignored). If that key was already recorded and its owner still exists and isn't soft-deleted → throws `IdempotentReplayException`, short-circuiting to a **200 replay** of the existing owner (no duplicate created). Otherwise does nothing.
2. **[V/S] `ValidateOwnerFields`** — binds `@RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` (the **only** body-binding step). First runs `OwnerAddresses.applyTo`: normalizes the address (structured `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` preferred over flat `address`; trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand `ST/RD/AVE`→`STREET/ROAD/AVENUE`) and composes a canonical flat `address` **[S]**. Then requires `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` all non-blank → else **400** `MissingOwnerFieldsException` naming each missing field. Publishes the validated body for later steps **[S]**.
3. **[V/S] `NormalizeOwnerTelephone`** — rewrites the telephone to E.164 in place **[S]**: strip spaces/dashes/brackets; a leading `+` keeps its country code, otherwise assume `+61` and drop one leading `0`. Must be 8–15 digits; known country codes enforce national length (`+61`→9, `+1`→10) → else **400** `InvalidTelephoneException`.
4. **[V/S] `NormalizeOwnerEmail`** — email is optional. If present, must be syntactically valid → else **400** `InvalidEmailException`; then lower-cased in place **[S]**. Absent/blank passes untouched.
5. **[V] `RejectDisposableEmailDomain`** — if an email is present and its domain is on the blocklist (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`) → **400** `DisposableEmailDomainException`.
6. **[S] `DeriveHouseholdId`** — computes a deterministic `householdId` = first 12 hex of SHA-256 over `V2|normalizedLastName|postcode` (null if no postcode) and publishes it as a pipeline variable. (Note: this reads `postcode` before postcode format is validated at step 11.)
7. **[V] `EnsureUniqueIdentity`** — the hard duplicate check. Computes `identityKey` = SHA-256 of `telephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName)`; if any non-soft-deleted existing owner has the same key → **409** `DuplicateIdentityException`.
8. **[V] `EnsureCityCapacity`** — counts existing owners in the same city (case-insensitive); if ≥ **50** → **409** `CityAtCapacityException`.
9. **[V] `EnsureDailyOwnerLimit`** — adjusts the effective registration date (supplied, else today) to a business day, counts existing owners registered on that day; if ≥ **100** → **429** `DailyOwnerLimitException`.
10. **[S] `BuildOwner`** — maps the DTO to an `Owner` entity via `OwnerMapper` and publishes it.
11. **[V] `ValidateOwnerPostcode`** — postcode optional; if present must be exactly 4 digits, and if the owner's **city** maps to a known region (Sydney→NSW 2000–2099, Melbourne→VIC 3000–3099, Brisbane→QLD 4000–4099) must fall in that range → else **400** `InvalidPostcodeException`.
12. **[S] `AssignHousehold`** — stamps the derived `householdId` onto the owner (if non-null).
13. **[S] `AssignHouseholdSize`** — sets `householdSize` = 1 + count of stored owners sharing the same non-null `householdId` (1 if no household).
14. **[S] `AssignMembershipLevelCap`** — if in a shared household, sets `membershipLevelCap` = max household member's level-for-current-size + 1 (unset otherwise).
15. **[V] `ValidateOwnerRegistrationDate`** — if a `registrationDate` was supplied and is after today → **400** `FutureRegistrationDateException`.
16. **[S] `DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate`** — sets `registrationDate` to the supplied value (or today if absent), rolled forward to the next business day (skipping weekends and the fixed 2026 public-holiday list) in place.
17. **[S] `AssignBulkSignupWarning`** — sets `bulkSignupWarning = true` if > **80** owners already exist for that business day.
18. **[S] `AssignCapacityWarning`** — sets `capacityWarning = true` if the city already holds **40–49** owners.
19. **[S] `AssignMemberId`** — computes and stamps the `memberId` (`<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` with a Luhn check digit), de-duplicating against existing member ids by appending `-2`, `-3`, ….
20. **[S] `AssignNamesakeCount`** — sets `namesakeCount` = count of existing owners sharing this first+last name (case-insensitive; 0 for the first).
21. **[S] `DetectPossibleDuplicate`** — soft match: if a non-deleted owner shares `soundex(lastName)` + `postcode` but has a different `identityKey`, sets `possibleDuplicate = true` and `possibleDuplicateOf` = lowest matching id; otherwise both cleared.
22. **[S] `SaveOwner`** — persists the owner via `OwnerRepository.save` (assigns its id).
23. **[S] `AuditOwnerCreated`** — logs a human-readable audit line plus a structured `schemaVersion:2` `OWNER_CREATED` event on the `AUDIT` logger, incrementing a process-wide sequence number.
24. **[S] `EnqueueWelcomeNotification`** — logs a welcome line (id + memberId) on the `NOTIFY` logger.
25. **[S] `RecordIdempotentCreate`** — if the request carried an `Idempotency-Key`, records key → new owner id in the `IdempotencyStore` (so step 1 can replay next time).
26. **[S] `RespondWithOwnerCreated`** — maps to `OwnerDto` and sends **201 Created** with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`.
